description: This source file contains the code-behind logic for the LoginPage of an online examination system. It manages user login functionality, including authentication for students via database queries and a simple admin login.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing login page events and authentication logic for students and admins.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load; currently empty.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the sign-up button click event, redirects users to the SignUpPage.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Authenticates users based on selected account type: students via database query, or admin via hardcoded credentials. Redirects accordingly.
